architecture: Contrato técnico documental v1 consolidado por Codex con decisiones de negocio del usuario v02. Único stack propuesto: React/Vite TypeScript FE, Fastify TypeScript API, PostgreSQL persistencia. Justificación: base inventariada contiene controlador/piloto Python, sin FE/API SaaS; Node22.18.0/npm10.9.3 disponibles; API/FE separados del controlador Python3.12.14 que permanece. Pins de dependencias y BD ausentes bloquean ejecución. Recorrido: visitante filtra directorio y abre WhatsApp del perfil; persona adulta se registra, completa perfil, sube fotos y activa plan de prueba para publicar. Un perfil por cuenta. Roles de autorización: member propietario, sin admin de producto en esta vertical. Basic/promoted son planes comerciales, nunca permisos. Directorio global público, no tenants organizacionales; escrituras y datos privados aislados por user_id autenticado. No chat/matching/likes. Dev/staging simulado, Rebill al final AGE-40. AGE-30/32 integración pendiente; contrato puede prepararse en paralelo. Todos los defaults técnicos aquí son propuestas para implementación; negocio confirmado Argentina ARS15000/30000 por mes calendario, cualquier género y18+. Fecha declarada se valida, no demuestra identidad ni verificación documental de edad. UI rutas /, /personas/:profile_id, /registro, /ingresar, /recuperar, /restablecer, /mi-perfil, /mi-plan en ui-contract.json. Raíz pública agrupa la página por plan: sección identificada Promocionados arriba y Listado básico debajo, sin repetir tarjetas, ambos con mismos filtros. Estados vacío/error/carga y verificación móvil360px/1280px especificados, no ejecutados.

routes.rule: Apply hierarchy filters to basic AND promoted; public eligibility; promoted DESC, created_at DESC, id DESC; keyset cursor bound to filter hash; one row per profile.
Same public eligibility as listing; expired, unpublished, incomplete or absent =404. No owner private fields.
Only loaded official AR catalog, parent filters validated. No catalog invented in this contract; unloaded catalog=503 catalog_unavailable.
Server catalog basic1500000/promoted3000000 centavos, monthly real billing. No client price accepted.
Adult age >=18 civil date America/Argentina/Buenos_Aires, no future date. One email case-insensitive. Set refresh cookie. Self-declared DOB, no identity verification claim.
Generic invalid_credentials for wrong user/password; new hashed refresh session and cookie.
Authenticate via refresh cookie, rotate transactionally, single use; reused revoked token revokes its family; CSRF same-origin rule.
Revoke refresh family and associated access sessions; clear cookie. Bearer required; no caller user_id.

response.message: string: Si la cuenta existe, recibirás instrucciones

routes.rule: Same status/body for known/unknown email. Persist reset hash only; delivery via Mailpit in dev/staging.
Token random32bytes hash SHA256, expires1h, once; transaction changes password, consumes token, revokes all sessions.
Owner from validated session; expired subscription does not block profile management.
One profile per user; geography composite FK; MOBILE only; published=true requires complete profile with main photo or422 incomplete_profile. Create initially published=false.
No user_id/profile_id from body. Lock owned profile; atomic validation; explicit publication requires completeness. Subscription expiry still200 for valid own edits.
Prevalidate bytes/decode/reencode in quarantine; lock owned profile; max5; first photo main; persist only safe object ref. Reject forged image415, huge decoded image422.
Photo ownership join via session; other owner404. Lock profiles row, unset old main then set new within transaction.
Lock profiles; delete owned photo; if main pick earliest remaining created_at,id; if no photos complete=false and published=false. Object cleanup after DB commit via reconciliation.
Derive expiry at server now; dates never regenerated at read or restart; owner can read while expired.

Idempotency-Key header required 1..128 ASCII chars. Body exactly plan_id; extra fields400. Production ALWAYS403 simulation_disabled before auth/body processing, even malformed/absent body. Replay within24h preserves original201 AND body. Server fixes owner/origin/price.
DB SELECT1 and validated config; no secrets, no simulated mutation.

listing.pagination: Keyset cursor opaque encoding last ordering tuple plus hash normalized filters. limit1..50 default20; changed filter or invalid cursor400. One EXISTS active subscription per profile avoids duplicate joins.
listing.eligibility: profiles.published AND server complete (all required fields+valid mobile+main photo) AND EXISTS subscription starts_at<=now AND ends_at>now. Both basic/promoted must satisfy same filters and eligibility. Detail uses identical rule. Whole AR geography hierarchy validated.
listing.deduplication: Exactly one profile per user UNIQUE(user_id); one listing row per profile using EXISTS and current plan resolved under no-overlap writer invariant. Promoted appears once, ahead of basic in same page stream.

api.error_shape: All errors JSON {error:{code:string,message:string,fields?:object<string,string>},request_id:string}.400 malformed/extra fields,401 invalid_session,403 simulation_disabled or CSRF,404 missing/not-visible/nonowner,409 conflict,413 bytes,415 media,422 semantic invalid,429 rate limit,503 service/transaction. No SQL, stack, secrets or account enumeration.

data.geography_consistency: UUID identifiers everywhere. profiles FK(zone_id,province_id,country_id) REFERENCES zones(id,province_id,country_id); zones FK(province_id,country_id) REFERENCES provinces(id,country_id); UNIQUE referenced composites. AR-only countries.code. Official province/municipality/barrio catalog is NOT fabricated; AGE-34/37 load source with identity. Test geography explicitly synthetic.
data.main_photo_constraint: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX photos_one_main ON photos(profile_id) WHERE is_main; at most one principal. Every photo mutation locks profiles row; nonempty set exactly one main enforced by transaction; last deletion unpublishes. Limit5 enforced after lock.
data.transaction_lock: Subscription activation BEGIN SELECT users(id) FOR UPDATE before checking current subscription or key. All future subscription writers same lock; no overlapping current interval. Idempotency PK(user_id,key), payload_hash NOT UNIQUE. Other-account same plan can have equal hashes.
data.restart: Persist all users/profiles/photos/plan snapshots/subscription starts_at/ends_at/idempotency response/sessions/reset hashes. API restart does not re-seed users or renew dates. Migrations explicit, never implicit startup resets. Public expiry derived at query time, no timer required.

auth: Public register/login/forgot/reset; refresh authenticates cookie, all /api/me/* and activation except production early guard require valid access session. JWT signed server key reference, exp15min, sub=user_id, sid=session id; API validates signature/issuer/audience/expiry and sessions revoked_at/expiry on each private request. Password Argon2id proposed m=65536KiB,t=3,p=1 with library defaults for random salt; library pin pending. Email trimmed/lowercase unique. Refresh random32bytes, SHA256 hash only DB, cookie HttpOnly Secure SameSite=Lax Path=/api/auth MaxAge7days; rotation locks session, revokes old and issues new same family; reuse revokes family, logout family, reset all sessions. Dev localhost HTTPS setup required before enabling secure-cookie flow; no weakened production config. Cookie-auth refresh additionally rejects Origin other than configured same origin; FE sends credentials, token stays in memory, no localStorage. Forgot-password always202 generic, random32bytes base64url reset email Mailpit(dev), hash DB,1h expiry,single-use; reset atomically consumes token/changes password/revokes sessions. Never log tokens. Proposed rate limits:5 failed logins/IP/15min,3 reset requests/IP/hour ->429. Registration DOB civil date America/Argentina/Buenos_Aires must compute age>=18; DOB private self-declaration, no stronger identity claim. Profile phone libphonenumber-js full metadata parses AR international E.164, isValid AND getType=MOBILE, fixed or FIXED_LINE_OR_MOBILE/unknown422; FE applies same library/metadata rule, server authoritative. This validates classification, not possession or WhatsApp account. Description plain text, escape rendering, never dangerouslySetInnerHTML. Public DTO permits intentional WhatsApp contact link only; exclude email,DOB,hashes,sessions,owner IDs and billing details. Ownership selected through sessions, no client user_id. Nonowned photo404; expired plan does not disable authenticated profile management.
photos: Proposal: max5 photos/profile, max5242880bytes/file, JPEG/PNG/WebP only, max4096x4096 and max16777216 decoded pixels. Upload streaming size cap before full buffering; signature/magic bytes sniff then sharp decode with limitInputPixels and reject animation/multipage/corrupt files; reencode static JPEG quality85 or PNG/WebP safe output, strip EXIF/metadata, validate output dimensions/bytes. Client Content-Type untrusted; unsupported/forged415, bytes413, decoded dimensions/animation422. Quarantine inaccessible publicly; only validated reencoded object key can be persisted. No SVG/script allowed, no cryptographic photo-signature requirement. Lock owned profiles row before count<=5 check and photo insert; first becomes main, partial unique photos_one_main. PUT main and DELETE lock same row, unset previous main then set within transaction; deleting main elects earliest created_at,id; final photo removal published=false, complete=false. UUID object keys generated server; no client file path. DB rollback triggers best-effort object removal; crash orphan reconciler enumerates unreferenced quarantine objects, never publishes them; after committed deletion cleanup can retry independently. Description max2000 plain text escaped; object GET only reencoded resources with nosniff and correct type.

transaction: Before parsing any input: NODE_ENV=production returns403 simulation_disabled, zero auth/body/catalog/DB writes. Only server configured dev or staging allowed; unknown environment fails closed.

Authenticate owner; validate Idempotency-Key, JSON object exactly {plan_id}; reject unknown keys400 and unknown/disabled plan422. Server catalog ARS snapshot; origin=simulated. Never accept price/user_id/origin/simulated.
BEGIN; SELECT id FROM users WHERE id=:session_user_id FOR UPDATE; row exists. All subscription writers, including future Rebill handler, must take same users lock.

Read idempotency row scoped(user_id,key). If expires_at>transaction_now compare SHA256 canonical JSON of full accepted payload: sorted UTF8 keys, plan_id exact string, no whitespace. Same hash: return stored status/body after COMMIT, no mutation. Different hash: ROLLBACK and409 idempotency_conflict.
If expired: delete scoped row in transaction. If EXISTS subscription starts_at<=now AND ends_at>now, COMMIT purge and return409 active_subscription, without new subscription or extending dates.

Otherwise create subscription UUID; starts_at=one transaction timestamp, ends_at=starts_at+30*24h UTC (technical test default). Insert idempotency scope/hash/status201/body full Subscription DTO/expires_at=now+24h, in SAME transaction.

COMMIT before responding201. Any precommit error ROLLBACK both subscription and response;503 transaction_failed. If commit result is uncertain, no blind repeat by controller; owner may retry same key to reconcile stored201/body.

idempotency.payload_hash: SHA256 of complete accepted normalized JSON {plan_id}; reject unknown fields. Hash is NOT UNIQUE, account scope in composite PK.
idempotency.same_payload: Within24h return stored ORIGINAL status201 and exact same JSON response_body, same id/starts_at/ends_at; no new row or extension. Compare payload BEFORE active check.
idempotency.after_ttl: Expired scoped key can purge. If subscription active409 active_subscription with no extension; if expired a new simulated30d activation can create201. After TTL original replay guarantee ends; key in another account independent.
